f-2: City of Promise is Charlottesville's hub for dual-generation early intervention. We equip children and families with the support, coaching, and whole-family tools they deserve, because education is a social issue no school can solve alone, and every kid deserves to learn to read.
f-6: Charlottesville City Schools has the highest Black–white literacy pass-rate gap in Virginia, despite boasting the second highest instructional cost per pupil. This isn't the school's fault, students bring their worlds into the buildings with them.
f-8: literacy proficiency gap, Black vs. white - highest in Virginia
f-12: instructional cost per pupil - 2nd highest in Virginia
f-19: Community School Coordinators (CSC) embedded at 4 Charlottesville City School sites, implementing initiatives like after-school tutoring, on-site food pantries, and the "Walking Bus."
f-22: A two-year wraparound program for working Charlottesville families. Parent education, family learning and engagement, and up to $7,000 in micro-financing to invest in self-sufficiency.
f-25: The parent-focused arm of our model. Parenting coaching, school advocacy, resource brokering, because a child's trajectory is heavily influenced by their parent's.
